displayed_values: Demonstration data from esphome/dashboard/preview.html; tariffs are example values only.
reproduce: Serve esphome/dashboard on loopback with python -m http.server 14083 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory esphome/dashboard
Open http://127.0.0.1:14083/preview.html in Playwright CLI Edge
Set demo tariffs via the local mocked settings form; gas 1.69, water 5.63
Capture 1440px desktop and 390px mobile from the page top through the consumption section
For the daily view select two usages, add a demonstration label to the screenshot region, then capture the first 1080px of the daily card
